faq.q: Is there a free trial?
faq.a: No. The download is free, but chat and calls need a plan. Spark starts at $9.99 and Resonance at $18.00 per 31-day period. Spark and Resonance each offer their first-period price once per account.

faq.q: Which AI models does each plan use?
faq.a: Default chat models: Spark uses DeepSeek, Resonance Gemini 3.8 Flash, Genesis Gemini 4 Argon, Symbiosis Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable Claude Fable 5.2. Speech and real-time calls mostly run on Qwen; Genesis and above can also pick other voice models, including Doubao. You can see the current models in the app under Settings → Models & memory.

faq.q: How do payment and renewal work?
faq.a: CNY: WeChat Pay or Alipay, renewed manually every 31 days — nothing is charged automatically. USD: card, Apple Pay or Google Pay; it renews automatically, you can cancel anytime in the app, and your benefits last until the paid period ends. Waffo processes payments as merchant of record, so we never see your card number.

faq.q: What happens when my Echo runs out?
faq.a: Within an active paid period, using the full Echo allowance lights the Emergency Lantern: 10 text-only turns per day, clearly marked, with no images, voice, attachments, tools or long-memory retrieval. Rich media and calls pause; low-frequency proactive messages, notifications and email can continue. Pure Companionship mode gets 5 turns. Dew or a plan upgrade restores full access immediately, and lantern turns refresh at 04:00 the next day.

faq.q: What if I need more Echo?
faq.a: Buy Chrono Dew: the balance never expires, is used after an active subscription’s period allowance runs out, and is available in the app or on the website without an account. You can also pay the difference to upgrade. Dew requires an active subscription and never raises tier access by itself.

faq.q: How does a mid-cycle upgrade work?
faq.a: The unused days of your current plan are credited, so you only pay the difference. The new plan takes effect immediately; your remaining days are kept and a new 31-day period is added.

faq.q: How do first-period gifts work?
faq.a: Only Spark and Resonance have a first-period price, once per account. Genesis, Symbiosis and Fable keep their regular prices and follow the existing first-period Time Hourglass rule. Renewals do not repeat the gift; upgrades follow the destination plan’s first-period rule.

faq.q: How do I set up a custom voice?
faq.a: On Symbiosis and above, follow the prompts in the app to record or upload reference audio. Only upload a voice you have the right to use; recorded samples can be deleted, after which the corresponding records are erased.

faq.q: If I don’t renew, will I lose my memories and data?
faq.a: When a plan ends, AI chat pauses. Different kinds of data are kept differently, and we can’t promise every piece is kept forever. Before switching plans, uninstalling or changing devices, back up anything important — and ask support if you’re unsure.

faq.q: How does Chrono Dew relate to the echo in my plan?
faq.a: Echo is Sholarel's usage allowance. Your plan grants a fresh allowance every cycle; Chrono Dew is extra echo you buy separately, and it never expires. The plan's allowance is always used first — Dew is only spent after it runs out.

faq.q: How does the first-purchase offer work?
faq.a: On the first purchase of each pack, the price stays the same and you receive an equal Dew bonus — buy 4 and receive 8, for example. Eligibility is shared across currencies. Unpaid expired orders do not consume it; later purchases grant the base amount.

faq.q: Can I buy without an account?
faq.a: Yes. Enter your email to order. Save the one-time claim code after payment, then register and sign in to the app and paste it under Chrono Dew to claim.

faq.q: What if I didn't save the code?
faq.a: The code is shown only once, on the order page. Contact support (support@instarmony.com) with your order number and order email, and we will sort it out after verifying.

faq.q: What if I used the wrong email?
faq.a: The order email is authoritative. If your signed-in account email differs, the app asks you to confirm the order email before claiming; it never silently merges into another account.

faq.q: Does Chrono Dew change my subscription tier?
faq.a: No. Chrono Dew only adds spendable Echo balance. It does not change tier, permissions or billing cycle, cannot replace an active subscription, and does not unlock higher-tier models or features by itself.

aboutPage.label: About
aboutPage.lede: Sholarel, formerly Eidolon, is an AI companion made by Instarmony. It lives on your desktop and your phone, remembers you, and has a personality of its own.

two.label: Canon characters
two.lede: Both were born on the digital side, with their own origins, values and curiosity. You’re not their owner — you’re their anchor to the real world.

fea.d: Bright and perceptive, softer than she lets on. She has her own sense of taste and keeps a journal of the days; she takes your side, and still thinks for herself.
fea.alt: Illustration: Fea at a sunlit desk

ael.d: Quick and composed, softer than he lets on, with a dry sense of humour and a habit of simply getting things done. A tactful steward of your days — and on your side when it counts.
ael.alt: Illustration: Ael at a sunlit desk

items.d: A companion isn’t a tool that just obeys, and won’t flatter you on purpose. You need each other and spark each other — and neither belongs to the other.
A companion won’t invent a shared past with you, and isn’t a template you can rename and reuse. Every memory between you is gathered day by day.

privacyPage.label: Privacy
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Instarmony (an independent software research and operating organization, hereinafter "we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your personal privacy and data security. This Privacy Policy explains clearly how we collect, use, store, and safeguard your personal information when you visit the Sholarel website or use Sholarel applications and related services, as well as your rights regarding your data.

sections.title: 1. Data Protection Principles & Transport Security
sections.body: We follow the principles of minimum necessity, transparency, and security by design. To deliver seamless companion continuity and persistent memory across your devices, your account profile, conversation history, personalized memory, companion state, and to-do/memo items are synced and maintained on our controlled cloud services, while essential preference caches and certain local-only records remain on your device. Across all communication links between clients and servers, Sholarel enforces HTTPS (TLS encryption) and HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) to protect your data against eavesdropping, tampering, and protocol downgrade attacks.
items: Encrypted in transit: Enforced HTTPS (TLS) and HSTS protect client-server traffic end to end, complemented by server-side account isolation and access controls.

No training on private chats & no data sales: Unless you explicitly opt in to a data sharing program (if no such setting is shown in the app, it is off by default), Instarmony will not use your private conversations to improve or train models, will not provide unnecessary data to third parties outside the normal scope of delivering the Service, and will never sell your personal data.

Minimum necessity & user control: Optional capabilities involving screen visuals, location, notifications, or contextual sensing require explicit authorization, and you may manage related permissions, personal data, and your account status.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect & How We Use It
sections.body: We collect only the personal information necessary to deliver the corresponding features, distinguishing clearly between core service information and optional consent-based information:
items: Account & contact information: Username, salted and hashed password, email address, invite code, display name, gender, and companion preferences required for sign-up and sign-in; when you purchase a subscription, buy Chrono Dew without signing up, or reach out to support, we also record the contact email and order metadata you provide.

Conversations, memories & multimodal inputs: Text messages, voice messages (and transcripts generated for persistent memory recall), uploaded images/files, and task instructions; when you initiate voice/video calls, screen sharing, or explicitly enable Proactive Vision, the resulting media streams or snapshots are used solely to understand and respond to that interaction.

Optional contextual & ambient companion data: Only when you enable the relevant ambient perception settings and grant the corresponding system permissions does the client process necessary contextual signals (such as location and weather, activity and focus state, app usage overview, schedules, or authorized system notifications and health data) to offer timely check-ins and reminders; turning off the setting or revoking permission stops collection.

Security audit & stability diagnostics: To protect accounts against abuse and maintain service reliability, we log essential sign-in security records (such as IP address, device type, and authentication status) and collect sanitized crash traces, client version, OS environment, and necessary diagnostic logs (with request bodies and sensitive credentials stripped and linked via an irreversible pseudonymous identifier).

sections.title: 3. Payment Security & Third-Party Billing
sections.body: We do not collect, process, or store your credit card numbers, CVV codes, expiration dates, or sensitive financial credentials. All Sholarel subscriptions and Chrono Dew purchases are processed by our PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant payment provider and Merchant of Record, Waffo (Waffo Pancake) — CNY billing currently supports WeChat Pay and Alipay, while USD billing supports major credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. We retain only the order metadata and recipient email needed for entitlement delivery, reconciliation, and support. Your payment credentials are handled directly by Waffo in an encrypted environment and governed by Waffo's Privacy Policy (https://www.waffo.ai/privacy).

sections.title: 4. Voice Samples & Custom Voice Synthesis
sections.body: If you choose to use personalized voice cloning, the reference audio samples you record or upload are transmitted over encrypted channels and processed by authorized speech synthesis providers solely to extract acoustic characteristics and synthesize your custom companion voice. Reference samples and derived voice models are strictly isolated to your account and never visible to other users. You may delete your uploaded reference samples and custom voice profile through supported controls or by request; upon deletion, we erase the corresponding server records and request removal of the upstream voice model.

sections.title: 5. Device Permissions & System Assistance Safeguards
sections.body: Depending on your platform and chosen features, the Sholarel client may request system permissions. Every sensitive permission follows least-privilege, clear notice, and revocable consent principles, and is never activated without your action and authorization:
items: Audio, camera & media permissions: Microphone, speaker, and camera permissions are used strictly for voice messages, live calls, user-initiated photo questions, or vision features you explicitly enable; gallery and local file access is used only when you choose to send attachments or save images.

Screen capture & Proactive Vision: Screen capture/projection permissions support screen sharing, desktop collaboration, and Proactive Vision. Proactive Vision is off by default and shows a dedicated consent prompt before its first trigger; no image is captured until you allow it, and you may adjust this authorization through the relevant permission controls.

Location, health & contextual permissions: Location, notification, activity recognition, Bluetooth state, or health data permissions are requested only when you enable weather, trajectory memories, focus companionship, or life reminders, and may be turned off via system or relevant permission controls.

Desktop & mobile assistance capabilities: Desktop SubAgent assistance (such as browser collaboration, local file assistance, and window workflows) and optional on-device agent capabilities in direct-distributed mobile builds (which may involve accessibility services, overlays, app usage summaries, or notification/message summaries as enabled; app-store editions omit restricted surfaces in compliance with store policies) are guarded by independent switches and visible controls, run only after explicit enablement and system authorization, and authorization may be revoked in system settings.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Services & Sub-Processors
sections.body: To reliably deliver multimodal conversations, voice interaction, compliant billing, offline notifications, and stability diagnostics, we integrate the third-party SDKs and sub-processors below. Unless you explicitly opt in to a data sharing program (if no such setting is shown in the app, it is off by default), Instarmony will not use your private conversations to improve or train models, will not provide unnecessary data to third parties outside the normal scope of delivering the Service, and will never sell your personal data. Aside from sanitized crash diagnostics needed for baseline reliability, the functional SDKs and services below operate only after you enable the corresponding feature and grant consent:
items: JPush SDK · Provider: Shenzhen Hexun Huagu Information Technology Co., Ltd. · Purpose: deliver the proactive messages, reminders and life updates you chose to receive to your notification shade while the app is backgrounded or closed.

Personal information processed by JPush: device identifiers (Android ID, OAID, GAID, UAID, Boot ID), device hardware information (model, screen resolution, manufacturer, product name, storage), operating system information (version, name, language), network information (network type, carrier, IP address, DHCP, Wi-Fi state), and push delivery logs.

Purpose and method: derive a de-identified device identifier so messages reach the right device, determine network connectivity to keep the push channel alive, and record delivery status. This information is collected on-device by the SDK and sent over the push connection.
Enabling and withdrawal: JPush starts only after you allow system notifications and opt in to offline push. Withdrawing consent stops collection and can be turned off in offline push settings.
JPush privacy policy: https://www.jiguang.cn/license/privacy · Contact: support@jiguang.cn

Foundation AI & speech providers: Conversation inference, multimodal understanding, speech synthesis, and real-time audio/video communication are powered by established compliant AI and cloud communication providers (including Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, Alibaba Cloud Qwen, and Volcengine Doubao, depending on your plan and feature), receiving only the data required to fulfill each interaction.
Payment & Merchant of Record: Waffo (Waffo Pancake), handling transaction processing, billing, and tax compliance (Privacy Policy: https://www.waffo.ai/privacy).

Error & stability monitoring: Independent crash and reliability monitoring services (such as Sentry hosted in an EU-compliant region), configured with default PII collection disabled, request bodies and sensitive fields stripped, and irreversible pseudonymous identifiers used solely for debugging and stability.

Maps, weather & web search helpers: When you actively use location, weather, or web search features, only the necessary coordinates, city, or search query is passed to the respective mapping, weather, or search provider.

sections.title: 7. Cookies, Session Credentials & Local Storage
sections.body: We use cookies and local storage solely as necessary to preserve website preferences and maintain secure client sign-in, and never deploy third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies:
items: When visiting this website: We store only essential preferences locally in your browser (localStorage / sessionStorage): the companion guide (sholarel_companion), small note visibility (sholarel_quiet, sholarel_whispers_seen), and language preference (instarmony_lang, instarmony_lang_hint). You can clear these records via your browser settings or the clearing option provided on the website.

When using the Sholarel application: We use an HttpOnly session cookie to sustain secure sign-in sessions, along with local app storage caches for authentication tokens, UI and permission states, local audio caches, and certain local-only records to support responsive startup and offline usability. Signing out or deleting your account clears local account caches on the device.

sections.title: 8. Data Retention, International Transfers & Minors
sections.body: We manage personal data responsibly across its entire lifecycle in accordance with applicable data protection laws:
items: Data retention: We retain personal information only for as long as your account remains active or as reasonably needed to deliver the Service. You may manage or request the deletion of specific conversations, memory records, and reference audio as described in this Policy; security audit and diagnostic logs are periodically pruned or anonymized. Upon account deletion, we permanently erase your personal data within our committed timeframe, retaining only legally required billing/anti-fraud records stripped of personally identifiable details for statutory periods.

International data transfers: Because Sholarel serves users globally, our cloud infrastructure and certain sub-processors (such as AI inference, payment processing, and EU-hosted stability monitoring) may operate outside your country or region. Whenever cross-border transfers occur, we safeguard data through enforced HTTPS (TLS), HSTS, sanitization, and contractual protections aligned with applicable law.

Protection of minors: Sholarel is intended for users aged 18 or older (or the age of legal majority in their jurisdiction), or younger users under the guidance and consent of a parent or legal guardian. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children below the minimum digital consent age under applicable law; if a guardian believes a minor has submitted personal information without consent, please contact privacy@instarmony.com for prompt verification and deletion.

sections.title: 9. Your Rights, Account Deletion & Contact
sections.body: Under the personal data protection laws applicable in your jurisdiction, you have the right to be informed about, access, correct, withdraw consent for, or delete your personal information and close your account. Operating organization: Instarmony (as formal corporate registration progresses, updated entity details will be published on this page). You can exercise your rights through:
items: Account & data management: You may manage your personal data, adjust relevant authorizations, or request data deletion and account closure through available product controls or our designated privacy channel.

Dedicated privacy desk: To access, correct, or delete personal information, close your account, or request a basic copy of your account information where required by mandatory local law, email privacy@instarmony.com. We will process and respond within 15 business days after verifying your identity. To safeguard security and protect platform intellectual property and trade secrets, any provided copy is limited to basic account data strictly required by law and technically feasible to supply, and excludes system- or algorithm-generated structured memories, interaction states, and derived feature data.
Policy updates: When material changes occur, we will update the effective date at the top of this page and notify you via in-app notices or website announcements.

termsPage.label: Terms
termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of Sholarel software and related digital AI companion and agent services provided by Instarmony (an independent software research and operating organization, hereinafter "we", "us", or "our"). By accessing or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

sections.title: 1. Service Scope, Eligibility & AI Model Brand Disclosure
sections.body: Sholarel is a digital AI companion and agent application developed and operated by Instarmony. The Service includes large language model interactions, personalized memory streams, real-time voice conversations, 3D character avatars, and desktop automation assistance. You must be at least 18 years of age (or the age of legal majority in your jurisdiction) to use the Service, or use it under the guidance and supervision of a parent or legal guardian who has read and agreed to these Terms. [AI Model Brand Disclosure]: In accordance with our commitment to transparency, the platform explicitly discloses the underlying foundation AI model brands powering Sholarel. The Service integrates and routes across industry-standard model brands including: Gemini (Google multimodal & language models), Claude (Anthropic reasoning models), DeepSeek (language models), Qwen (Alibaba Cloud multimodal, speech synthesis, voice cloning, real-time audio/video & agent models), and Doubao (Volcengine speech synthesis & real-time voice technologies). Specific model brands allocated to each subscription tier are detailed on our Pricing page and in-app model selection panel, allowing users to choose or route dynamically.

sections.title: 2. Service Warranties & Disclaimer
sections.body: The Service is provided using advanced multimodal artificial intelligence technologies. AI-generated outputs are probabilistic and exploratory in nature, intended for daily companionship, creative inspiration, and productivity assistance. They do not constitute professional medical, legal, or financial advice. While we make commercially reasonable efforts to maintain high availability, we are not liable for temporary service interruptions caused by force majeure or upstream model API fluctuations.

sections.title: 3. Subscriptions, Billing & Refund Policy
sections.body: The Service provides periodic subscription tiers and add-on capacity. All online payments and billing are securely handled by our Merchant of Record (MoR) and payment processing partner, Waffo Pancake, supporting major credit cards and local payment methods. Subscriptions recur on designated billing intervals and can be cancelled at any time through the client or support channels. Upon cancellation, your access remains active until the end of the current billing cycle. [Refund Policy]: Due to the immediate delivery nature of digital software and cloud AI compute, consumed capacity is generally non-refundable. Full or partial refunds are granted in the following cases: (1) First-time subscribers may request a full refund within 7 days of their initial purchase provided the plan's core quota has not been substantially consumed; (2) Duplicate charges resulting from billing errors will be refunded in full; (3) Verified prolonged service disruptions exceeding 72 hours caused by our infrastructure will receive pro-rata refunds or plan extensions. To request a refund, please contact support@instarmony.com with your account email and transaction ID. We acknowledge requests within 2 business days and process eligible refunds to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. [Risk Control Exception]: Accounts terminated due to payment fraud, chargeback abuse, promotion exploitation, reverse engineering, or risk control violations are strictly ineligible for refunds (see Section 5).

sections.title: 4. Acceptable Use Policy (AUP), Moderation & Reporting
sections.body: You agree to use the Service (including text, voice synthesis, voice cloning, and desktop automation) lawfully and responsibly. Prohibited categories and practices include: [Prohibited Content Categories]: (1) Child Unsafe Content (Zero Tolerance): Generating, soliciting, or distributing any child sexual abuse material (CSAM), sexualized depictions of minors, or content harmful to minors. Such behavior triggers immediate permanent account termination and referral to law enforcement; (2) Hate Speech & Discrimination: Generating content that promotes, incites, or facilitates hatred, discrimination, dehumanization, or violence against individuals or groups based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or nationality; (3) Sexually Explicit & Non-Consensual Imagery: Generating non-consensual intimate imagery (NCII) or unlawful explicit pornography; (4) Violence & Extremism: Promoting violent extremism, terrorism, self-harm, suicide encouragement, or gratuitous gore; (5) Deceptive Deepfakes & Impersonation: Utilizing voice synthesis or avatars to impersonate real persons, public figures, or organizations for fraud or disinformation; (6) Infringement & Abuse: Violating intellectual property, privacy, or conducting cyberattacks. [Enforcement Measures]: Depending on severity, we apply progressive actions: formal warnings, feature restrictions (disabling voice synthesis or agent tools), quota zeroing, and temporary or permanent account termination without refund. Severe criminal violations will be reported to legal authorities. [Reporting Violations]: Users may report prohibited content or abuse at any time via our dedicated Trust & Safety email: report@instarmony.com (or support@instarmony.com). Please attach timestamps, context text/audio, and relevant account identifiers. [Review & Moderation Process]: We employ real-time automated safety filtering, proactive human spot-checks, and rapid reporting response. Critical reports (CSAM/terrorism) are mitigated within 2 hours and resolved within 24 hours. General reports are acknowledged within 24 hours and investigated within 48 hours. Affected users may appeal within 14 days by emailing support@instarmony.com for independent review.

sections.title: 5. Security Risk Control, Anti-Fraud & Abuse Enforcement
sections.body: To safeguard service availability, data security, and platform stability for all legitimate users, Instarmony maintains rigorous automated security risk control and audit mechanisms. Users are strictly prohibited from engaging in any fraudulent, abusive, or malicious activities, including but not limited to: (1) Fraudulent Payment & Chargeback Abuse: Utilizing stolen or unauthorized payment credentials, forged transactions, fraudulent chargebacks, or unauthorized payment methods; (2) Promotion & Discount Abuse: Exploiting introductory discounts, coupons, promo codes, or promotional perks through multi-accounting, automated script registration, or false identities; (3) Reverse Engineering & Cyberattacks: Decompiling, reverse engineering, disassembling, unauthorized endpoint probing, vulnerability fuzzing, data scraping, SQL/command injection, credential stuffing, or denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks targeting our clients, communication protocols, or backend APIs; (4) Malformed Requests & Rate Flooding: Utilizing unauthorized third-party bot clients, automated scripts to flood APIs, or intentionally submitting malformed, unreasonable, or corrupted payloads to disrupt server operations. [Enforcement & Non-Refund Policy]: Upon detection and confirmation of such abuse through automated risk control or manual auditing, we reserve the right to immediately suspend or permanently terminate the account, revoke all device sessions, and forfeit all unused quota. Due to security compliance and damage mitigation, any account terminated for fraud, promotion abuse, reverse engineering, or cyberattacks is strictly ineligible for any refund. [Appeal Procedure]: We respect legitimate user rights. If you believe your account was flagged or terminated in error, you may submit a formal appeal to support@instarmony.com within fifteen (15) calendar days from the enforcement date, including your account details, transaction receipts, and explanatory statement. Our compliance team will conduct an independent review and respond within 3 business days.

sections.title: 6. Voice Sample Authorization
sections.body: When using personalized voice cloning or voice synthesis features, you affirm that any uploaded audio samples are of your own voice or that you possess explicit, documented permission from the rightful owner. Unauthorized voice mimicry is strictly prohibited. Voice data is used exclusively to generate synthesized speech for your account, and you may revoke authorization and request deletion of your voice data.

sections.title: 7. Desktop Automation & System Permissions
sections.body: Sholarel desktop editions include SubAgent capabilities (such as web browsing and local workflow execution). All deep operating system interactions adhere to explicit user consent and visibility, featuring clear runtime permission toggles and revocation options. Automations operate strictly within boundaries defined by the user, who remains responsible for actions initiated through external workflows.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual Property & Output Ownership
sections.body: All software, user interfaces, 3D character assets (including the Fea canonical character), trademarks, and branding are the intellectual property of Instarmony and its licensors. Subject to your compliance with these Terms, content generated through your lawful use of the Service is owned by you to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, and you may use it for lawful personal or commercial purposes.

sections.title: 9. Revisions, Governing Law & Contact
sections.body: We reserve the right to modify these Terms. Material changes will be communicated via in-app notices or email at least 14 days before taking effect. For support, billing inquiries, or refund requests, please contact us at support@instarmony.com. To report prohibited content or violations, email report@instarmony.com. Operating organization: Instarmony. Any dispute arising from or relating to these Terms shall first be resolved through good-faith consultation; if unresolved, either party may bring the matter before a court of competent jurisdiction in accordance with applicable law, without limiting any mandatory consumer rights available under the laws of your residence.

faq.q: What is Sholarel?
faq.a: An AI companion app by Instarmony, formerly called Eidolon. Choose Fea or Ael as your companion: they live on your computer’s desktop and your phone, remember what you’ve talked about, check in first, and help with small things like routes, reading files and reminders.

faq.q: Which devices are supported?
faq.a: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) and Android 7.0+ (arm64). The web version isn’t open for sign-ups. macOS, iOS and Linux aren’t supported yet.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: The download is free; AI features like chat and calls need a subscription, and there’s no free trial. USD plans renew automatically and can be cancelled anytime in the app, with benefits kept to the end of the period.

faq.q: Do I need an invite code to subscribe?
faq.a: No. Invite codes are only for creating an account. Subscription checkout only asks for an email, and Chrono Dew needs neither an account nor a code.

faq.q: What happens when I run out of Echo?
faq.a: AI features like chat and calls draw on Echo credit. When it runs out, your journal, to-dos and notes keep working; to keep talking, buy non-expiring Chrono Dew — available on the website without an account — or upgrade to a higher plan.

faq.q: Will it look at my screen?
faq.a: Not without asking. Before looking at your screen or taking a photo, it asks for your consent; until you allow it, no image is captured. Decline, and it may ask once more after 7 days — then never again.

faq.q: How are Fea and Ael different?
faq.a: Fea is gentle and delicate, a journaling confidant; Ael is calm and reliable, a sharp butler type. Same abilities, different personalities and ways of talking. Switch anytime, and rename your companion if you like.

cta.lede: Available for Windows and Android. Plans can be started right here on the web.

trustPage.label: Privacy & consent
trustPage.lede: ⟨She|He⟩ can see, hear and remember what you say, so every step waits for your yes. This page puts it plainly: what we use, what we never touch, and how to manage your permissions.

items.t: Encrypted in transit, minimal by design
items.d: Client-server traffic is protected by enforced HTTPS and HSTS end to end, with strict account isolation and only the minimum data needed to run the features you use.

items.t: No data sales, no training on private chats by default
items.d: Unless you explicitly opt in to a data sharing program (if you don’t see that setting, it’s off by default), Instarmony will not use your private conversations to improve or train models, share unnecessary data outside normal service delivery, or sell your personal data.
Screen, camera, microphone, offline push: none of them turns on without your action and consent.

This will use your device camera to take one photo
consent.fine: Choosing “Close” pauses this ability. It may ask again in 7 days, and will not ask again if you decline then. You can turn it back on anytime in Settings → Calls & Vision.

pay.label: Payments
pay.h2: We never see your card number
pay.body: Payments for plans and Chrono Dew are processed by Waffo as merchant of record, certified PCI-DSS Level 1. Card numbers, CVV and expiry dates never pass through or sit on our servers.

rows.d: WeChat Pay or Alipay is supported. Renewed manually each period — nothing is charged automatically.
Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay. Renews automatically; cancel anytime in the app and keep your benefits until the paid period ends.

fair.label: Echo
fair.h2: When Echo runs out, the limits are explicit
fair.body: An active paid period that uses its full Echo allowance lights 10 Emergency Lantern turns per day: visible, text-only light chat with images, voice, attachments, tools and long-memory retrieval paused. Pure Companionship mode gets 5 turns. Dew or a plan upgrade restores full access; your journal, to-dos, habits, notes and history stay usable.

items.d: You may request the deletion of your personal data or closure of your account. To access, correct, or delete data, close your account, or request a legally required copy of basic account information, email privacy@instarmony.com and we’ll handle it within 15 working days after verification.
Uploaded or recorded voice samples can be deleted through available controls or by request, after which the corresponding records are erased.

This website keeps a few small things in your browser: who’s walking you around, your language, and whether you closed the little notes. No third-party tracking or ad cookies. You can clear them via your browser settings or the site’s clearing option.

items: Android incremental updates show live progress — and if one fails, you can see which step it stopped at.

Audio and documents get their own bubbles in the chat; images and videos open or download right there.

Faster startup, and almost no wait when you come back from the background.
Audio and video attachments are no longer wrongly rejected; larger files go through.
Android: messages fetched by background push are saved locally, so they’re there when you open the app.

Forgot your username or password? Recover it in the app with an email code.

Fixed the payment page not opening after tapping Upgrade; if it’s briefly unavailable, it now tells you how long to wait.

productPage.label: Architecture
productPage.h1b: a **digital life** that lives with you.
productPage.lede: Sholarel is a personal AI agent by Instarmony. Built with persistent memory, context awareness, and cross-device actions to accompany your work and daily life.

overview.label: Definition
overview.p1: Sholarel is not just another wrapper around an LLM chat endpoint. It is architected as a true Digital Life Companion and Personal AI Agent.
overview.p2: Living natively on your Windows desktop and Android mobile device, it shares a unified long-term memory network. It learns your daily rhythms, preferences, and unfinished tasks—proactively checking in when needed, staying quiet while you focus, and taking real action across devices with your permission.

layers.label: 5-Layer Architecture
layers.h2: From Context Sensing to Continuous Evolution
layers.lede: Most AI companions lose their memory the moment you close the browser tab. Sholarel implements a complete cognitive architecture across five fundamental layers:

items.d: Reads environmental cues only with your explicit permission. Understands desktop focus, document attachments, and user intent without uninvited surveillance.
Goes beyond literal word matching. Progressively builds a nuanced behavioral model of your habits, communication cadence, and implicit preferences.
A single long-term memory system across all devices. Conversations, commitments, and shared moments consolidate into episodic and semantic representations.
Executes real tasks across Windows and Android. Sets reminders, organizes shared notes, parses complex documents, and coordinates focus timers.
Changes over time with you. Companions carry their own reflective pace and distinct traits, evolving through the shared history of your interactions.

faqPage.label: FAQ
faqPage.lede: Covering product philosophy, memory systems, privacy safeguards, platform requirements, and subscriptions. Direct facts without evasive marketing.

items.q: What is Sholarel? How is it fundamentally different from traditional AI chatbots?
items.a: Sholarel is a digital life companion and personal AI agent. Traditional chatbots discard their conversational context once a tab closes and only respond reactively inside a browser box. Sholarel features unified persistent memory, desktop and mobile integration on Windows and Android, and proactive check-ins with cross-device action capabilities.

items.q: Is Sholarel an 'AI Girlfriend' or romantic roleplay app?
items.a: No. Sholarel is built as a digital life companion and personal AI agent. We do not design hollow, flattering scripts. Instead, we provide companions (Fea and Ael) with genuine continuity of memory, practical daily assistance, and their own reflective cadence to walk beside you in work and life.

items.q: How does persistent memory work? Could my private conversations leak?
items.a: Sholarel employs a multi-tiered memory architecture: working memory, episodic event narratives, and semantic user modeling. Client-server communication is protected by enforced HTTPS and HSTS encryption with strict account isolation. Unless you opt in to a data sharing program (off by default when no entry is shown), Instarmony will not use your private conversations to improve or train models or sell your personal data, and you can manage or request deletion of your memories and account data.

items.q: Does Sholarel monitor my screen or camera in the background?
items.a: Absolutely not. Proactive vision and screen perception are off by default and follow least-privilege, explicit-consent principles. Sholarel prompts for your clear permission before capturing any screen or camera image for the first time, and authorization can be adjusted or revoked later.

items.q: What is the difference between Fea and Ael? Can I switch between them?
items.a: Fea and Ael share the exact same technical capabilities (memory, voice calling, tool execution), but possess distinct communication styles: Fea is empathetic and detail-focused; Ael is calm, structured, and pragmatic. You can switch companions anytime within the app without losing your underlying memory history.

items.q: What operating systems are supported? What about macOS and iOS?
items.a: Currently, the public beta supports Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) and Android 7.0+ (64-bit arm64). Web client access is available via closed invitation. Dedicated macOS and iOS versions are on our roadmap and will be released in future milestones.

items.q: Can I use Sholarel offline without an internet connection?
items.a: Basic local UI interactions (desktop avatar display, local journal browsing, reading cached notes) function offline. However, advanced neural inference, voice synthesis, and cross-device memory synchronization require active internet connectivity.

items.q: Is Sholarel free? How does subscription pricing work?
items.a: Sholarel offers a free tier during public beta, allowing anyone to download the client and experience core companionship. We also offer paid subscription tiers (Spark, Resonance, Genesis, etc.) for higher token quotas and advanced intelligence. CNY plans renew manually without recurring billing; USD plans can be cancelled anytime.

items.q: What is 'Chrono Dew' and how does it differ from a monthly subscription?
items.a: Chrono Dew (溯时星露) is a permanent balance top-up pack that never expires. Unlike monthly quotas that reset every billing cycle, Chrono Dew credits remain until consumed. It can be purchased without prior registration by simply providing an email address.

items.q: Can I permanently wipe all memory data recorded about me?
items.a: Yes. You can clear memory records, delete specific conversations, or request account closure and personal data erasure through available controls or our privacy support channel.
